name: answrank
description: Audits a website for answer-engine visibility (AEO/GEO) across 8 categories with a 0-100 score, tests brand citation rate across 5 AI models, and generates ready-to-copy robots.txt, llms.txt and JSON-LD. Audit and fix generation need no API keys; citation testing requires one or more LLM provider keys.

ANSWRANK_DB_PATH.description: SQLite path for audit/citation history. Defaults to the package data dir.

PERPLEXITY_API_KEY.description: LLM provider key for citation testing (only needed by answrank_citations).

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: LLM provider key for citation testing (only needed by answrank_citations).

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: LLM provider key for citation testing (only needed by answrank_citations).

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: LLM provider key for citation testing (only needed by answrank_citations).

MISTRAL_API_KEY.description: LLM provider key for citation testing (only needed by answrank_citations).

ANSWRANK_GROUNDING.description: Set to 0 to disable live grounding fetches during audits (offline-ish mode).

tools.name: answrank_audit
tools.description: Audit a website for AI answer-engine visibility (AEO/GEO) across 8 categories; returns a 0-100 score, crawl warnings, lost-revenue estimate and recommendations.

tools.name: answrank_citations
tools.description: Run sector questions across 5 AI models to measure a brand's citation rate. Requires at least one LLM provider API key.

tools.name: answrank_generate_fixes
tools.description: Generate ready-to-copy robots.txt, llms.txt and JSON-LD schema for a domain. No API key required.

privacy.keys: LLM provider keys are read from the environment and used only for citation testing; they are never logged or persisted. Audit and fix-generation tools run without any key.
privacy.network: answrank_audit fetches the target URL; answrank_citations calls the configured LLM providers. answrank_generate_fixes makes no network calls.
